acceptance_reason: Total governed fluid amount remains conserved within the declared numeric representation tolerance; cross-boundary exchange is symmetric/explainable and stale work cannot replace newer state.

definition.fail_criteria: Fluid appears/disappears beyond tolerance, boundary order changes semantic outcome outside declared envelope, or stale state commits.
definition.inconclusive_conditions: Fluid is represented only visually or the fixture has no measurable conserved quantity.
invalidation_conditions: Evidence is unusable due to wrong build/configuration, measurement defect or contamination.
A proof run without adequate exact build identity may be INVALIDATED.
definition.pass_criteria: Total governed fluid amount remains conserved within the declared numeric representation tolerance; cross-boundary exchange is symmetric/explainable and stale work cannot replace newer state.
procedure: Move finite fluid through openings across simulation partitions.
Delay either exchange side, randomize order, and unload/reload mid-transfer.
Inject a stale pre-breach result after a newer revision.
definition.question: Can bounded local fluid cross simulation-cell/partition boundaries without creating or deleting conserved volume or allowing stale boundary work to overwrite newer fluid state?
definition.required_repetition: At least 10,000 boundary exchanges across seeds/update orders plus long-duration conservation runs.
definition.title: Fluid Boundary Breach

observations: Cross-partition exchange was symmetric and every deliberately stale result was quarantined.
